title: ConMem: Counterfactual Multi-Scenario Probing for Resolving LLM Memory Misalignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.33432v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term memory is critical for autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agents executing multi-session, long-horizon tasks. However, existing memories often inappropriately store, retain, or retrieve over-generalized, misattributed, or privacy-sensitive information, a problem we term memory misalignment. To study this problem, we construct \textbf{MemAlign}, a benchmark comprising 1,079 curated memory cases grounded in synthetic, validated multi-session conversational contexts covering diverse misalignment taxonomies. We then propose ConMem, an algorithm that reframes retention decisions as prospective counterfactual causal inference. \textbf{ConMem} synthesizes counterfactual interaction scenarios to prospectively audit downstream intervention effects across three aspects: relevant task execution, irrelevant invariance checks, and risk-sensitive boundary shifts. Experiments show that ConMem outperforms other methods, achieving 75.16\% ac

translated_title: ConMem：基于反事实多场景探测解决大语言模型记忆错位问题
translated_abstract: 长期记忆对于执行多会话、长周期任务的自主大语言模型（LLM）智能体至关重要。然而，现有的记忆机制常常不恰当地存储、保留或检索过度泛化、错误归因或涉及隐私敏感的信息，我们将这一问题称为记忆错位。为了研究这一问题，我们构建了MemAlign基准，该基准包含1,079个精心策划的记忆案例，这些案例基于合成的、经过验证的多会话对话上下文，涵盖了多样化的错位类型。随后，我们提出了ConMem算法，该算法将记忆保留决策重新构建为前瞻性的反事实因果推断问题。ConMem通过合成反事实交互场景，前瞻性地审计下游干预效果，涵盖三个方面：相关任务执行、无关不变性检查以及风险敏感的边界变化。实验表明，ConMem优于其他方法，达到了75.16%的准确率……
tldr: 提出ConMem算法，将记忆保留决策重新构建为前瞻性反事实因果推断，通过合成反事实交互场景审计记忆的下游影响，并构建MemAlign基准（含1,079个记忆案例），有效解决了LLM智能体长期记忆中存储、保留或检索不当信息的记忆错位问题。
